text:
A ray of light travels in air.
The ray strikes a glass block. The angle between the ray and the block is 60°.
The speed of light in air is 3.0 × 108
m/s.
The speed of light in glass is 2.0 × 108
m/s.
What is the angle of refraction in the glass block?
A
19°
B
35°
C
40°
D
75°
subject: Physics
